text:
Samir: FYI AcmeHealth reports 403s for both generation and embeddings after we migrated their SSO profile yesterday. Customer says calls that worked earlier now fail with "insufficient_scope".
Aisha: thanks — can you paste the exact error body + one repro curl?
Samir: reproduced locally with their token. repro: 
```bash
TOKEN=redacted
curl -s -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.prod/v1/generate" -d '{"input":"test"}'
```
Response: 
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"insufficient_scope", "required": ["generate", "embeddings"], "message": "token missing required scopes"}
```
Samir: same token shows up in auth logs with scopes claim: 
```
{"sub":"svc-acme-123","scopes":"embeddings","iss":"sso.example.com"}
```
Tom: saw the auth logs too — the upstream ingress is rewriting the scopes claim on JWT introspection. It truncated everything after the first comma/space. Looks like the migrator wrote space-separated scopes and the edge parser only picks the first token.
Riley: confirmed — ingress sidecar has a config that normalizes scope header: `X-Auth-Scopes: embeddings generate rerank` -> it treats as a CSV and picks first value because of a bug in split logic (splits on comma only). If SSO started emitting scopes as space-delimited (RFC 6749 allows spaces), our parser mis-parses and drops the rest.
Aisha: this would explain a sudden customer-wide break after SSO update. Is there a quick mitigation so Acme can get back online?
Tom: short-term: create a service key that explicitly lists the combined scopes ("generate embed rerank") and have them use that key while we patch the sidecar. I created a temporary key for them: `sk-temp-acme-2026` (rotated after 24h).
Riley: long-term fix: update ingress sidecar to split scopes by whitespace too, and accept either space or comma separators. Patch in progress: https://stash.redwood/internal/changes/ING-3456 (wip).
incidents-bot: incident ING-3456 created and assigned to eng-infra. Priority: P2.
Samir: added repro steps to the ticket and uploaded customer error payloads + auth dump. Also added curl pointing at our introspection endpoint: 
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://auth.redwood.prod/introspect | jq .
```
```
{
  "active": true,
  "sub": "svc-acme-123",
  "scopes": "embeddings"
}
```
Aisha: can eng-infra expedite the sidecar patch? Customer on trial so need minimal downtime. Also advise CS to offer customer the temp key + step-by-step to swap in their app.
Riley: patch is small, rolling canary overnight. I pushed a hotfix branch to the sidecar repo that adds `split(/[\s,]+/)` for scopes parsing. Will coordinate with eng-sre for rollout.
Tom: note for postmortem — add a unit test for space-delimited scope tokens and update our SSO onboarding docs to state we accept both delimiters.
Samir: ack. I've shared the temp key with the customer and will follow up after the canary. Closing loop here once sidecar roll is green. :white_check_mark:
Aisha: great, please ping when canary completes and include remediation steps for other tenants that might have space-delimited scopes.
